title: Celery Worker & Beat Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying Celery distributed task workers and Celery Beat schedulers.

CELERY_SERVICE_USER.description: User account used to run the Celery worker daemon.

CELERY_QUEUES.description: Comma-separated list of task queues consumed by the Celery worker.

CELERY_CONCURRENCY.description: Number of concurrent Celery worker child processes.

CELERY_BEAT_ENABLED.description: Whether to run the Celery Beat periodic task scheduler alongside the worker.

CELERY_BROKER_URL.description: Message broker connection URL for Celery (e.g., redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0).

PYTHON_VENV.description: Python virtual environment path into which Celery is installed and launched.

GROUP.description: Primary system group assigned to the Celery daemon user account.

PYTHON_VERSION.description: Python runtime version provisioned for the Celery virtual environment.

CELERY_LOG_DIR.description: Directory for Celery worker and beat log files.

CELERY_RUN_DIR.description: Runtime directory for Celery PID and beat schedule state files.

CELERY_USER_HOME.description: Home directory path assigned to the Celery service user.
